Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring labels that specify fuel tax rates to be affixed to gas pumps.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fuel tax information; and adding a new sectionto chapter 19.112 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.112 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director shall create an adhesive label specifying thecurrent federal and state motor vehicle fuel and special fuel taxrates. The label should be chemical and weather resistant. The labelmust be updated as necessary to reflect current motor vehicle fuel andspecial fuel tax rates. (2) Beginning January 1, 2007, a current adhesive label, asdescribed in subsection (1) of this section, must be affixed on eachretail motor vehicle fuel pump in the state. (3) For the purposes of this section, a "retail motor vehicle fuelpump" means any weighing device as defined by RCW 19.94.010 from whichmotor vehicle fuel is dispensed for retail sale.
